basic_info.description: One of the largest residences at the Golden Gateway. This exceptional house-like condominium offers 2,438 square feet on three levels. Designed for elegance & comfort, this home features 3BR 3BA + Den, two patios and a rooftop terrace with sweeping views of the Bay Bridge, downtown skyline and the city's most iconic landmarks. The dramatic main level is defined by soaring 17-foot ceilings, expansive east-facing windows that capture the morning light and an open modern layout. The nicely updated kitchen features new quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, walk-in pantry and patio for convenient grilling. Upstairs, the primary suite is a quiet retreat, featuring a spa-inspired bathroom with luxurious finishes, a walk-in closet, and wood-burning fireplace. A second bedroom and laundry room complete this level. A wide interior staircase leads to the crown jewel: A private rooftop terrace with commanding views of the Bay Bridge and many of San Francisco's most iconic landmark buildings. One-car parking, abundant storage, and the rare scale and versatility of a true house-like residence.
